90:1: Nay, I swear by this city.
90:2: And you are a resident of this city.
90:3: And by the father and that which he fathered.
90:4: By oath, We created man in hardship.
90:5: Does he think that no one will have power over him?
90:6: He says: I have consumed much wealth.
90:7: Does he think that no one saw him?
90:8: Did We not make two eyes for him
90:9: Did We not make a tongue and two lips
90:10: And We showed him the two ways.
90:11: But he could not plunge into that steep ascent.
90:12: And what made you know what that steep ascent is?
90:14: Or feeding an orphan on a day of hunger.
90:15: Feeding an orphan who has kinship.
90:16: Or feeding a poor person spread on the dust.
90:17: Then he became of those who believed and enjoined patience upon one another and enjoined mercy upon one another.
90:18: Those are the companions of the right.
90:19: And those who deny Our verses, those are the companions of the left side.
90:20: Over them is a closed fire.
